acme_demo_admin: Hey team — our production API started returning 429s around 14:03 UTC and the org credits show 0, but the dashboard still says next refill at 02:00 local time. We didn’t expect a reset until end of month. Any clue?
alyssa_support: sorry about that — can you paste the org id and a curl snippet that reproduces the 429? :sorry:
acme_demo_admin: org: org_99123. Repro from our side:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-REDACTED" \
  -H "X-Org-ID: org_99123" \
  -d '{"model":"open-200b","input":"hello"}'
```
Response: 429 QUOTA_EXHAUSTED, body: {"error":"monthly_credits_depleted","next_refill":"2025-10-01T00:00:00Z"}
alyssa_support: thanks — that's useful. Quick checks: did you recently migrate or merge projects into this org, or apply a promo/top-up? Those can trigger a recalculation job that runs in the background.
jordan_eng: tagging in infra: we saw a small window yesterday where the billing reconciler and the streaming debit path raced on commits after an org-merge, which could cause a temporary double-debit on long-lived streams. quota_bot: automated note — billing job run: 2025-09-15T13:46:11Z; reconcile-id: rec_78d9
acme_demo_admin: we did merge 3 projects at 13:40 UTC and had a few long-running stream sessions still active.
alyssa_support: likely explanation: the immediate merge caused credits to be reallocated, but active streams kept consuming pre-merge session tokens; reconciler later corrected balances but UI/next_refill display lagged for a few minutes. Workarounds: restart active streams or rotate the key to force new session tokens (short term).
jordan_eng: quick repro steps for the SRE team if you want to reproduce locally:
1) create org A and org B with small monthly buckets
2) open a streaming session in org A that continuously emits tokens
3) merge A into B and apply promo top-up at same time
4) observe debit logs and reconcile job; look for two decrement records for same session id in a ~30s window
We have a pending patch to make session-debit atomic (Lua script on redis) to prevent double-debits.
acme_demo_admin: ok will restart streams as a stopgap, thx. Any ETA on the patch?
jordan_eng: aiming for a canary deploy this week, full rollout early next week. I'll DM you on follow-up and share patch id. :rocket:
alyssa_support: leaving this open until you confirm restart fixed it — ping here when done and we’ll keep monitoring credits. :thumbsup:
